operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. ADM-01, HS-01 through HS-07, IWB-01, IWB-02, PMP-01, PMP-02, SEC-01, and SKI-01)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall only be operated in situations arising from sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events where primary energy/power source is disrupted or disconnected (e.g., electrical grid failure, on-site disaster, public service emergencies), or for participation in an ISO-declared emergency (e.g., abnormal system conditions, capacity deficiency, fuel shortage, abnormal natural events, external ISO events), or for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), or for unscheduled maintenance, testing, and operational training, or for the integration operational period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: All diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. ADM-01, EG-01 through EG-166, HS-01 through HS-07, IWB-01, IWB-02, PMP-01, PMP-02, SEC-01, and SKI-01)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operate and maintain gen-sets and control devices according to manufacturer's written instructions or permittee-developed procedures approved by the engine manufacturer. Only permitted settings changes that do not increase air emissions are allowed.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. ADM-01, EG-01 through EG-166, HS-01 through HS-07, IWB-01, IWB-02, PMP-01, PMP-02, SEC-01, and SKI-01)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No operation for scheduled maintenance checks and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), stack testing, or operational training (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30. Exceptions may be petitioned to the Regional Air Compliance Manager of DEQ's NRO.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. ADM-01, EG-01 through EG-166, HS-01 through HS-07, IWB-01, IWB-02, PMP-01, PMP-02, SEC-01, and SKI-01)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During the integration operational period, any operation (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30 shall only occur if the forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) for ozone for Northern Virginia is less than or equal to 100. If an Air Alert for Metropolitan Washington, D.C. is issued for a day with forecast AQI <= 100, operation shall be minimized to the maximum extent practical.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. ADM-01, HS-01 through HS-07, IWB-01, IWB-02, PMP-01, PMP-02, SEC-01, and SKI-01)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 500 hours per year for all purposes combined. Annual limits calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. ADM-01, HS-01 through HS-07, IWB-01, IWB-02, PMP-01, PMP-02, SEC-01, and SKI-01)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 35 hours per year for Scheduled MCRT. Annual limits calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: All diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. ADM-01, EG-01 through EG-166, HS-01 through HS-07, IWB-01, IWB-02, PMP-01, PMP-02, SEC-01, and SKI-01)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Approved fuel is diesel fuel oil, defined as ultra-low sulfur diesel fuel oil (ULSD), renewable diesel, or a blend. Must meet ASTM D975 for grade ultra-low sulfur 2-D or 2-D S15, or have a maximum sulfur content not to exceed 0.0015% by weight (15 ppm), and either a minimum cetane number of forty or maximum aromatic content of thirty-five volume percent.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: All diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. ADM-01, EG-01 through EG-166, HS-01 through HS-07, IWB-01, IWB-02, PMP-01, PMP-02, SEC-01, and SKI-01) combined
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Combined quantity of diesel fuel consumed each consecutive 365-day period shall be less than or equal to the sum of: Group 1 (Caterpillar 3516E SCR & cDPF operating) 8,346,450 gallons + Group 2 (Caterpillar 3516E SCR not operating & cDPF operating) 673,144 gallons + Group 3 (Caterpillar C18) 717,806 gallons + Group 4 (Caterpillar 3512C) 683,314 gallons + Group 5 (Caterpillar C15) 1,043,864 gallons + Group 6 (Caterpillar C9) 1,331,445 gallons. Compliance demonstrated daily by adding total for most recently completed calendar day to individual daily total for preceding 364 days.
